note: City of Laurens municipal campground (Time To Spare Campground) in Sportsman's Park, southeast Laurens off S East Street. Gravel pads with cable, beside the park's ball fields, playground, trail, disc golf course and two small stocked fishing ponds; restrooms and a covered picnic area. Free golf cart/ATV/UTV tags for the length of a stay. Open dates not published. RV Life 7.0/10. --Claude
summary: Confirmed water and electric hookups, dump station, phone reservations through City Hall, and the $15 rate (undated). Amperage and site count are not on the city page. Not waterfront stands (ponds ~0.5 acre, ~50 m away). Pin is ~150 m off, in a house lot.
flags: WATERFRONT not waterfront stands. Imagery shows the campground as 5 gravel pads with grass islands on the east side of S East Street. The two stocked fishing ponds to the east are each about 45 x 55 m (~0.5 acre), well under the ~5-acre pond threshold, and ~50 m away across lawn and a trail.
FEES: '$15 / night' is posted with no date (the page's only photo was uploaded in 2020), so it does not meet the 2024 dating rule. Left as stored.
PIN: stored 42.84600,-94.84200 falls in a residential lot west of S East Street, ~150 m NW of the pads. Under the 250 m threshold; a precise pin would be 42.8448,-94.8410 if wanted.
SITES/ELECTRIC: the city page gives neither the site count nor amperage. Imagery shows 5 pads, consistent with the stored count 5 (derived); electric 30 (derived) is unconfirmed.
Phone 712-841-4526 and website confirmed. The campground photo shows a Class A and trailers on the pads, so a 23-ft rig fits.
